notes.title: Playtest now live!
notes.content: [p]It's been some time since the last update and we have some big news. Firstly, we finally started truly implementing the Santorini assets and can now get rid of the placeholders. The game is really starting to look like we imagined it when we started out there have also been many new mechanics added, I will list them below. [/p][list][*][p]Many new Assets,[/p][/*][*][p]A boat system,[/p][/*][*][p]Undo and Redo buttons,[/p][/*][*][p]Bird-AI,[/p][/*][*][p]Water,[/p][/*][*][p]Music,[/p][/*][*][p]new UI and options menus,[/p][/*][*][p]many smaller bugfixes,[/p][/*][/list][p]Now for the big news. We just put up a playtest on Steam, which you can play now! We are giving away a key to whoever posts the best city on the ⁠#🏠city-sharing channel of our discord. We will announce the winner at the end of the playtest by the end of the month. Good luck and have fun trying out the playtest and tell us what you think :)  [url="https://discord.gg/tjJnjMS4QW"]Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.2 is now out on itch!
notes.content:
[p]Desktop Town just got its first Update!  Update includes:[/p][list][*][p]A totally overhauled placing system that now only requires drag and drop without configuring the height of objects with the mouse wheel.[/p][/*][*][p]The mouse wheel now lets you rotate objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the railway set and a basic tram system for you to build in your town.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved AI[/p][/*][*][p]New UI[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Many small bug fixes and performance improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Have fun trying out the new stuff and stay tuned for more stuff to come :)[/p][p][/p][p]--> [url="https://edelerde.itch.io/desktop-town"]Itch Page[/url]  <--
[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/B7tSHaXZ"]Join us on Discord![/url][/p]
